import json
def transform(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
    rs=sorted(p[0] for p in pts); cs=sorted(p[1] for p in pts)
    n=len(pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    vertical = (cs[-1]-cs[0]) > (rs[-1]-rs[0])
    if vertical:
        med=(cs[(n-1)//2]+cs[n//2])//2
        for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1):
            if out[r][med]==0: out[r][med]=3
        for r,c in pts:  # horizontal branch along row r to spine col
            for x in range(min(c,med),max(c,med)+1):
                if out[r][x]==0: out[r][x]=3
    else:
        med=(rs[(n-1)//2]+rs[n//2])//2
        for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1):
            if out[med][c]==0: out[med][c]=3
        for r,c in pts:  # vertical branch along col c to spine row
            for x in range(min(r,med),max(r,med)+1):
                if out[x][c]==0: out[x][c]=3
    return out

import json
def transform(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    from collections import Counter
    rc=Counter(r for r,c in pts); cc=Counter(c for r,c in pts)
    best_r=max(rc.values()); best_c=max(cc.values())
    if best_c>best_r:  # vertical spine
        med=max(cc,key=lambda c:(cc[c],-c))
        lo,hi=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
        for r in range(lo,hi+1):
            if out[r][med]==0: out[r][med]=3
        for r,c in pts:
            for x in range(min(c,med),max(c,med)+1):
                if out[r][x]==0: out[r][x]=3
    else:  # horizontal spine
        med=max(rc,key=lambda r:(rc[r],-r))
        lo,hi=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
        for c in range(lo,hi+1):
            if out[med][c]==0: out[med][c]=3
        for r,c in pts:
            for x in range(min(r,med),max(r,med)+1):
                if out[x][c]==0: out[x][c]=3
    return out
